messages:
Noah: quick ping — a user reported an unreachable link from the "Integrations" page to the 'rate-limits' section. URL ends with `#rate-limits` but jumps to top of page in prod. Anyone own that fragment? :eyes: Zara: I was in that doc earlier. Might be a slug rename after the MDX tidy. Which page exactly? Noah: /kb/integrations/overview#rate-limits (customer email included the full link). Repro: click TOC link -> top of page. Marta (Docs): thanks — that usually means the heading id changed. I can grep for heading variants. Eli: quick debug: `rg "rate[- ]limits|Rate limits" content/ -n || true` shows heading is now `Rate limiting` -> slug `rate-limiting`. Old anchor was `rate-limits`. Noah: ok, options: add compat id on heading, update callers, or add a fragment redirect. Which is lowest risk for immediate fix? Marta (Docs): compat id is lowest friction. I'll open a tiny PR that adds `

Rate limiting

` above the heading so existing deep links keep working, then we do a sweep to update callers to canonical slug. link-checker-bot: nightly fragment-scan flagged 2 broken fragments linking to `#rate-limits` on pages: /kb/integrations/overview and /kb/onboarding/api-quickstart. Ticket KB-8877 created (severity: medium). Zara: can you also include a one-line note in the heading comment like "compat: old anchor rate-limits" so future editors see the intent? Marta (Docs): yes. PR coming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9812 — tiny compat id + inline comment. Will mark for staging-only canary first. Eli: staging canary requested. Please ping when deploy-bot queues it so I can sanity-check the onboarding quickstart which is cached in marketing. deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for branch fix/compat-rate-limits by Marta. CI: lint OK, linkcheck pending. Noah: will test staging once live and check the customer-reported URL. If all good, merge and schedule a sweep PR to update the callers to `#rate-limiting` and add owners check. Zara: I'll take the sweep after this merges. ETA 3h. Will search for `rate-limits` and update top-5 callers, add changelog entry. Marta (Docs): thanks — merging after CI + quick docs review. I'll also add KB-8878 to backlog to run a weekly fragment-scan and auto-ping owners when slugs change. Eli: appreciated. Small fixes like this save a lot of support time. :raised_hands:
